title: Houthis Claim Strikes on Saudi Arabia; Egypt Confirms Troop Presence in Kingdom
detail: Houthis claimed strikes on Saudi Arabia, and Egypt confirmed it has troops in the kingdom. Reported via a news aggregator; the Houthi claim and details are not independently verified.

title: Gulf States Plan Kuwait-Based Military Command as Houthi and Iranian Threats Grow
detail: Gulf states are reportedly planning a Kuwait-based military command amid growing Houthi and Iranian threats. Reported via a news aggregator; details not independently verified.
